instructions: Haggle hard. Open low, push back on every price, and play vendors against each other. Only accept when a vendor stops moving or in the final round. Pick the best value that meets our requirements.

scenario.title: Launch Video
scenario.tagline: Commission a 60-second launch video in 10 days.
scenario.brief: Commission a 60-second product launch video, delivered within 10 days. We must own the final assets outright (full ownership). Fast delivery, more revision rounds, a voiceover and a strong portfolio are a plus.
